details.description: Matcha Powder Instant Tea is a vibrant green tea powder that offers a refreshing and energising experience. details.storageInstructions:
Hot Brew: Whisk with 50 ml cool water, then add 200–500 ml of hot water or milk.
Cold Brew: Shake with 50 ml cool water, then add to 300–600 ml of iced water, milk or juice.
Storage Advice: Keep in a cool, dry and hygienic place. Once opened, consume immediately. Do not buy if found torn or puffed.
